statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic contributors to these symptoms
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is clinically warranted to characterize the cardiac rhythm underlying these symptoms and guide management
